name: Buffoon Runners
summary: Welcome to Buffoon Runners, Buffoon Runners is a Gorilla Tag fangame made by me, Coral. In this game you can connect with friends, family members, whoever you want! We have a Discord server listed in the game's website if you would like to join too. Have fun and follow the Terms of Service so that you do not get banned! We currently have a website that's lists our privacy policy if you would like to see it. This is my first game ever and I hope that everyone who plays the game enjoys!
